instructions.name: accept_authority_transfer
docs: Accept a pending authority transfer (only after the lock expires).

accounts.name: new_authority
docs: The pending new authority — must sign to accept the transfer

instructions.name: batch_mint_actor_nft
docs: Batch-mint up to 10 Actor NFTs (delegator signature required).
Prices follow on-chain bonding curve: Price = P0 × 20^(minted/total_supply).
canonical_payload: actor_batch|{actorCollectionId}|{walletAddress}|{quantity}|{totalAmount}|{orderNo}|{expiresAt}

accounts.name: creator
docs: The user wallet (NFT owner + SPL pay-token authority). Signs but need not hold SOL.

accounts.name: sponor
docs: Pays Core asset rent and should be the transaction fee payer off-chain.

instructions.name: batch_refill_actor_stamina
docs: Refill up to 5 Actor NFTs in one order (delegator signature + pay token -> treasury).
canonical_payload: actor_stamina_batch_refill|{orderNo}|{actorNftIds}|{payAmountMinors}|{expiresAt}

instructions.name: cancel_authority_transfer
docs: Cancel a pending authority transfer (only during the lock window).

instructions.name: cancel_config_update
docs: Cancel a proposed config update (only during the lock window).

instructions.name: commit_config_update
docs: Commit a proposed config update after the time lock has expired.

instructions.name: create_actor_collection
docs: Create an actor collection (any user + delegator signature).
canonical_payload: actor_collection|{actorCollectionId}|{creatorAddress}|{baseUrl}|{totalSupply}|{feeAmount}|{initialPriceAmount}|{r}|{expiresAt}

accounts.name: collection
docs: Core collection PDA — derived from `asset_id`.

instructions.name: create_collection
docs: Admin creates a Collection NFT (e.g. drama; actor uses `create_actor_collection`).

accounts.name: collection
docs: Core collection PDA — derived from collection_type.

accounts.name: collection_info
docs: Registry PDA — derived from collection_type, stores the collection address.

instructions.name: mint_series_nft
docs: Mint a Series NFT (delegator signature required).
canonical_payload: drama|{dramaId}|{creatorAddress}|{metadataUrl}|{feeAmount}|{expiresAt}

accounts.name: asset
docs: Core asset PDA derived from drama_id — prevents minting same drama twice.

accounts.name: collection_info
docs: Registered series Core collection (`create_collection` with matching `collection_type`).

accounts.name: pay_token_mint
docs: Payment token mint (compile-time constant; see `utils::pay_token::PAY_TOKEN_MINT`)

instructions.name: propose_authority_transfer
docs: Propose transferring authority to a new pubkey (time-locked).

instructions.name: propose_config_update
docs: Propose a timelocked config update (treasury, admin, delegator, pause).
`story_token_mint` is not settable here — it is immutable after `set_story_token_mint`.
Must wait lock_duration_secs before calling commit_config_update.

accounts.name: pending_config
docs: PendingConfig PDA — created on first proposal, reused/overwritten on subsequent ones.
Use init_if_needed so proposing twice overwrites the old proposal.

instructions.name: refill_actor_stamina
docs: Refill actor NFT stamina (delegator signature + pay token → treasury).
canonical_payload: actor_stamina_refill|{orderNo}|{actorNftId}|{payAmountMinor}|{expiresAt}

accounts.name: asset
docs: Core actor asset — must already be minted.

instructions.name: update_config
docs: Immediate config update (authority only).
Honored fields: `paused`, `new_platform_royalty_share`,
`new_actor_seller_fee_basis_points`, `new_drama_seller_fee_basis_points`.
`new_authority` is rejected — use `propose_authority_transfer` / `accept_authority_transfer`.
`new_admin` / `new_delegator` are rejected — use `propose_config_update` / `commit_config_update`.
`treasury` and `story_token_mint` are not accepted here either.

instructions.name: upgrade_actor_nft
docs: Upgrade actor NFT: burn materials and update main URI (delegator signature).
canonical_payload: actor_upgrade|{actorCollectionId}|{amount}|{mainAssetId}|{burnAssetIds}|{metadataUrl}|{orderId}|{expiresAt}

accounts.name: collection_mint
docs: Core actor collection.

accounts.name: mint
docs: Main actor Core asset to upgrade.

types.name: ActorCollectionCreatedEvent
docs: Emitted when a user creates an actor collection (delegator-signed).

types.name: ActorNftBatchMintEvent
docs: Emitted when multiple Actor NFTs are batch-minted.
Per-NFT metadata lives on Core assets; historical mint prices are in `mint_prices`.
Mint indices are contiguous: `start_mint_index..=end_mint_index`.

fields.name: pay_amount
docs: Actual mint cost transferred to treasury (bonding-curve sum).

fields.name: total_amount
docs: Signed `totalAmount` cap from the canonical payload.

types.name: ActorNftUpgradeEvent
docs: Merge upgrade: burn material NFTs and update the main actor NFT URI.

fields.name: order_id
docs: Backend order id from signed payload (analytics only).

fields.name: new_level
docs: New on-chain `level` after this upgrade.

types.name: ActorStaminaBatchRefill
docs: On-chain idempotency record for a batch stamina refill order.
Uses the same PDA seed as `ActorStaminaRefill`, so an `order_no` can only be
consumed once across the single and batch refill instructions.

types.name: ActorStaminaBatchRefillEvent
docs: Emitted when a user pays to refill multiple Actor NFTs in one order.

types.name: ActorStaminaRefill
docs: On-chain idempotency record for a stamina refill order (keyed by `SHA256(order_no)`).

types.name: ActorStaminaRefillEvent
docs: Emitted when a user pays to refill actor NFT stamina.

types.name: CollectionInfo
docs: On-chain registry for a collection NFT (drama or actor).
Actor collections are keyed by `asset_id` (PDA seed). Drama collections use
`collection_type` as `asset_id` for backward compatibility.

fields.name: asset_id
docs: PDA seed for this collection (`collection_mint` / `collection_info`).

fields.name: name
docs: Actor: metadata `base_url` (`{base_url}{id}.json`); Drama: full collection URI.

fields.name: latest_mint_index
docs: Latest mint index assigned under this collection. Next mint uses `latest_mint_index + 1`.

fields.name: mint_price
docs: Bonding-curve price of the most recently minted NFT (P0 before any mint).

fields.name: p0
docs: Immutable initial mint price P0 (set at collection creation).

fields.name: total_supply
docs: Max actor NFTs mintable under this collection (0 = unlimited).

fields.name: creator
docs: Creator wallet that created the collection (signed payload).

fields.name: seller_fee_basis_points
docs: Royalty bps snapshot at collection creation; new mints read live config (`actor_*` or `drama_*`).

types.name: CreateCollectionParams
docs: Parameters for `create_collection`

fields.name: collection_type
docs: Used as PDA seed for the mint: [CollectionInfo::MINT_SEED, collection_type]
e.g. "drama" or "actor" (max 16 chars)

types.name: DramaNftMintEvent
docs: Emitted when a Series/Drama NFT is minted

fields.name: pay_token
docs: SPL token mint used for the creation fee payment

fields.name: fee_amount
docs: Handling fee paid to treasury (in pay_token's smallest unit)

fields.name: authority
docs: Contract management: pause, update config

fields.name: admin
docs: Can create Collection NFTs

fields.name: delegator
docs: Backend signer for delegated mint / stake operations

fields.name: story_token_mint
docs: The STORY SPL token mint; set one-time via `set_story_token_mint`, immutable thereafter.

fields.name: pending_authority
docs: Pending new authority for two-step transfer (Pubkey::default() = none)

fields.name: transfer_locked_until
docs: Unix timestamp after which pending authority transfer can be accepted

fields.name: latest_order_no
docs: Global monotonic orderNo nonce for replay protection on signed instructions.
Repurposed from `rollback_until`; binary layout unchanged (Borsh encodes i64/u64 identically).

fields.name: treasury
docs: Treasury wallet address — all payments are sent to this wallet's ATAs.
Also used as the sole Metaplex secondary-royalty recipient for actor / drama NFTs.

fields.name: platform_royalty_share
docs: Platform share in Metaplex secondary-market royalty (0–100).
Actor NFTs use platform-only royalty; default is 100.

fields.name: actor_seller_fee_basis_points
docs: Metaplex secondary-market royalty bps for actor NFTs (0–10000).

fields.name: drama_seller_fee_basis_points
docs: Metaplex secondary-market royalty bps for drama NFTs (0–10000).

fields.name: reserved
docs: reserved space for future config fields

types.name: InitializeParams
docs: Parameters for `initialize`
`admin` and `delegator` are required — must be non-zero pubkeys.
Setting them at init time avoids a separate update_config call + lock-wait.

types.name: PendingConfig
docs: Stores a proposed config update that has not yet taken effect.
Created by propose_config_update; applied by commit_config_update.
Changes are NOT applied to GlobalConfig until commit is called after
the time lock expires.

fields.name: proposer
docs: The authority who proposed this update

fields.name: executable_at
docs: When this proposal can be committed (Unix timestamp seconds)

types.name: ProposeAuthorityTransferParams
docs: Parameters for `propose_authority_transfer`

fields.name: new_authority
docs: The new authority pubkey to transfer to

fields.name: lock_duration_secs
docs: How many seconds to lock before the transfer can be accepted
Typical: 86400 (1 day) to 604800 (7 days)

types.name: ProposeConfigUpdateParams
docs: Parameters for `propose_config_update` (timelocked fields: treasury, admin, delegator, pause).
`story_token_mint` is intentionally NOT included — it is immutable after
`set_story_token_mint` (changing it would brick the stake vault and orphan
staked tokens; see `set_story_token_mint` doc).

fields.name: lock_duration_secs
docs: Minimum seconds to wait before committing (e.g. 86400 = 1 day)

types.name: SignedParams
docs: Parameters shared by all delegator-signed instructions:
`mint_series_nft`, `batch_mint_actor_nft`, `upgrade_actor_nft`,
`refill_actor_stamina`, `batch_refill_actor_stamina`.
`canonical_payload` is a pipe-delimited UTF-8 string whose format
depends on the instruction (see each handler's doc comment).
`sig` is the 64-byte Ed25519 signature the backend produces over
SHA256(canonical_payload).

types.name: UpdateConfigParams
docs: Parameters for `update_config`.
Only royalty fields and `paused` are honored — all are immediate (no timelock).
Sensitive fields (`authority` / `admin` / `delegator` / `treasury`) are NOT
here: `authority` uses `propose_authority_transfer` → `accept_authority_transfer`;
`admin` / `delegator` / `treasury` use `propose_config_update` → `commit_config_update`.

fields.name: new_actor_seller_fee_basis_points
docs: Actor NFT Metaplex royalty bps (0–10000). Immediate — no timelock.

fields.name: new_drama_seller_fee_basis_points
docs: Drama NFT Metaplex royalty bps (0–10000). Immediate — no timelock.
